n: Kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s) are lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes' flight the boosters are dropped and the Atlas core continues to orbit under the power of the sustainer engine (and the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for increased performance. As a sustainer engine, the LR105 has relatively poor sea level specific impulse compared to most boosters, but somewhat better vacuum specific impulse--though the difference in both is nowhere near as pronounced as when comparing a booster to an upper stage engine. Diameter: [1.5 m].

t: 用于R-7“老七”及其衍生型号的芯级发动机，衍生型号包括斯普特尼克、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号和闪电号运载火箭。与助推器发动机系列（RD-107）相比，它的室压和推力更低，游机布局更展开。在发射台上与助推器同时点火，并在极长（约5分钟）的燃烧时间内持续为R-7家族芯级提供动力。直径：[1.85 m]。

n: The power plant of the PGM-11 Redstone Short Range Ballistic Missile (SRBM). Originally designed for Ethanol/LOX (A-6) it was later adapted to use Hydyne/LOx (A-7) with approximately 6% higher performance (yet more toxic) for use in Jupiter-C / Juno I. When the Redstone was adapted from Jupiter-C for manned use under the Project Mercury (Mercury-Redstone Launch Vehicle - MRLV), the A-7 was switched back to Ethalox, accepting a slightly lower performance for the lack of toxicity. Thrust Vector Control (TVC) was provided by carbon thrust vanes and additional attitude control was provided by actuating fins placed in the guidance section. Diameter: 1.77 m.
s: The power plant of the PGM-11 Redstone Short Range Ballistic Missile (SRBM). t: PGM-11红石短程弹道导弹（SRBM）的动力装置。最初设计使用乙醇/液氧（A-6），后经改进使用海丁/液氧（A-7），性能提升约6%（但毒性更高），用于朱庇特-C/朱诺一号。当红石从朱庇特-C改进用于水星计划载人任务（水星-红石运载火箭 - MRLV）时，A-7重新换回乙醇/液氧，以牺牲少量性能换取无毒性。推力矢量控制（TVC）由碳素燃气舵提供，制导段的可动翼面提供额外的姿态控制。直径：1.77 m。

s: Pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able / Thor-Agena / Thor-Delta / Delta.

n: The S5.92 is a Russian rocket engine currently powering the Fregat upper stage. The S5.92 engine was developed for use on the Phobos missions, then later adapted for use on the Fregat space tug which currently serves as the orbital stage for the Soyuz and Zenit launch vehicles.
s: The S5.92 is a Russian rocket engine currently powering the Fregat upper stage. The S5.92 engine was developed for use on the Phobos missions, then later adapted for use on the Fregat space tug which currently serves as the orbital stage for the Soyuz and Zenit launch vehicles.
t: S5.92是一款俄罗斯火箭发动机，目前为“巡航（Fregat）”上面级提供动力。S5.92发动机最初为火卫一任务研发，随后被改进用于Fregat轨道拖船，后者目前作为联盟号和天顶号运载火箭的轨道级使用。

s: The Castor 1 was first used for a successful suborbital launch of a Scout X-1 rocket on September 2, 1960. Castor 1 stages were also used as strap-on boosters for launch vehicles using Thor first stages, including the Delta-D. Diameter: [0.79 m].

s: Small, but powerful solid fueled booster used as the first stage for the Aerobee line of Sounding Rockets.

n: The STAR 5D rocket motor was designed and qualified to serve as the rocket-assisted deceleration (RAD) motor on the Mars Pathfinder mission. Three of these motors were fired to slow the Pathfinder spacecraft to near-zero velocity before bouncing on the surface of Mars.
s: The STAR 5D rocket motor was designed and qualified to serve as the rocket-assisted deceleration (RAD) motor on the Mars Pathfinder mission. Three of these motors were fired to slow the Pathfinder spacecraft to near-zero velocity before bouncing on the surface of Mars.

s: A Soviet high performance semi-cryogenic upper stage engine. Originally developed as an upper stage for the R-7, it was later adapted to to Kosmos-2 Launch Vehicle, which needed a high performance upper stage due to the low performance of its R-12 first stage.
t: 苏联高性能半低温上级发动机。最初作为R-7的上级发动机研发，后来适配于宇宙-2运载火箭，由于该火箭的R-12第一级性能较低，因此需要一款高性能上级。

n: Later Viking engines used on Ariane 4. Includes configs for Viking 5B, 5C and 6 (liquid fuel booster). [1.5m]
s: Later Viking engines used on Ariane 4. Includes configs for Viking 5B, 5C and 6 (liquid fuel booster). [1.5m]

Multiple small exhaust nozzles are used to diffuse the exhaust plume and eliminate a recirculation zone that could contaminate spacecraft instrumentation and avoid potential extensive erosion of the landing site.

t: 海盗号着陆器终端下降发动机（TDE）。着陆器装有三台此类发动机，用于降落火星表面最后45秒左右的减速阶段。采用多个小型排气喷嘴以分散尾流羽流，消除可能污染航天器仪器的再循环区，并避免着陆点发生严重的土壤冲刷。

s: Secondary liquid engines for the Agena upper stage system. Attach to the gap in the truss on the Agena-D for intended use. Unintended use is not covered under warranty, but is encouraged. Includes a supply of fuel.
t: 用于阿吉娜上面级系统的辅助液体发动机。按设计用途安装在阿吉娜-D桁架的空隙处。超出设计用途的使用不在保修范围内，但值得一试。自带推进剂补给。

n: World's first closed-cycle kerolox vacuum engine. The S1.5400 served as an R-7 upper stage and the RD-58 (an upgrade) as upper stage / OMS for many Soviet and Russian launchers and spacecraft (Proton, N1, Zenit, Buran...). The S1.5400 was designed for the Blok L stage which was the final stage for the Molniya configuration of the R-7, used to launch communication satellites and interplanetary probes. Unlike prior upper stages, it was restartable (this was needed to perform apogee kick to place Molniya satellites in their final orbits). It was given the industry designation 11D33. An upgraded version, termed 11D33M, had slightly improved performance. The RD-58 is a derivative of the 11D33M engine with higher performance (industry designation 11D58); it has been used on many Russian launchers and is still in use today on Proton and Zenit. In comparison to hydrolox upper stages, kerolox ones do not suffer boiloff as badly and need far less volume (kerosene being far denser than liquid hydrogen), but have much lower specific impulse. Diameter: [2.0 m].

t: 世界上第一台闭式循环煤油液氧真空发动机。S1.5400 曾用作 R-7 上面级，而 RD-58（升级型）则作为许多苏联和俄罗斯运载火箭及航天器（质子号、N1、天顶号、暴风雪号……）的上面级/OMS。S1.5400 专为 Blok L 级设计，该级是 R-7 闪电构型的末级，用于发射通信卫星和行星际探测器。与以往的上面级不同，它具备多次启动能力（这是将闪电卫星送入最终轨道执行远地点变轨所必需的）。其工业代号为 11D33。被称为 11D33M 的升级版本性能略有提高。RD-58 是 11D33M 发动机的高性能衍生型（工业代号 11D58）；它已广泛应用于许多俄罗斯运载火箭上，并且至今仍在质子号和天顶号上服役。与氢氧上面级相比，煤油液氧上面级蒸发损耗不严重，所需容积也小得多（煤油密度远高于液氢），但比冲要低得多。直径：[2.0 m]。

s: The RD-8 is a four-chamber, staged combustion, vacuum kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the second stage of the Zenit launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control. Diameter: 3.9 m.

n: The "SNTP-PFE" series is a 1000MW reactor. The reactor is a particle bed using metallic carbide coated uranium granules embedded in a graphite rod that hydrogen is passed through. This allows for power densities of up to 40MW/liter. Its core is capable of starting up five times. An integral Tungsten Boron Lithium Hydride composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket has impressive stats for its size (Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2720 Ideal ISP=991 Reactor Power=1054MW(th) TWR=13.94 Chamber Pressure=6800kPa Ignitions =5 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:1.504tons ) The nozzle is a fixed ablatively cooled filament wound carbon-carbon design.

t: "SNTP-PFE"系列是一款1000MW反应堆。该反应堆为颗粒床设计，采用嵌入在氢气流经的石墨棒中的碳化金属涂层铀颗粒。这使得功率密度可高达40MW/升。其堆芯能够启动五次。包含一套整体式钨-硼-氢化锂复合屏蔽罩，整个组件采用再生冷却。次级回路将关机吹扫气体通入小型热机，以最大限度减少燃料损失并提供基本发电机电力。该发动机应安装在距离最近燃料箱三至六米处。燃料应作为乘员屏蔽体，运转时乘员位置应距离发动机十至十五米。额外的屏蔽（如水箱或高密度燃料）可在一定程度上减少该距离。这台火箭在同尺寸下拥有惊人的参数（喷管 Ae=100，燃烧室温度=2720，理想比冲=991，反应堆热功率=1054MW(th)，TWR=13.94，燃烧室压力=6800kPa，点火次数=5，含整体阴影屏蔽总重：1.504吨）。喷管为固定式烧蚀冷却缠绕碳-碳复合材料设计。

n: The Rutherford Engine is the worlds first electric turbo-pumped LOX/RP-1 engine. Rutherford adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance Lithium Polymer batteries to drive its turbo-pumps. The engine is named after the famous New Zealand born physicist Ernest Rutherford.
